title: Understanding the Log-Odds
text: The log-odds, or the logarithm of the odds ratio, is a way to express the relationship between the probability of an event occurring and not occurring. In logistic regression, this is expressed as log(P(Y=1|x)/P(Y=0|x)). Consider how this expression relates to the linear combination of features and coefficients.

title: Exploring Linearity
text: If we assume that the log-odds is linear, what does this imply about the relationship between the features and the coefficients in the logistic regression model?

title: Connecting Log-Odds and Linear Models
text: In logistic regression, the log-odds is modeled as a linear function of the input features. This means that the expression $$x^T \beta$$ is linear. Think about how this linearity affects the overall model and its predictions.
